bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; requiring proof of citizenship or lawful immigration status as a prerequisite to receipt of rental assistance or down payment assistance; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462A.07, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462A.07, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 22.+]

[+Proof of lawful residency; housing assistance.+]

[+The agency must require proof of citizenship or lawful immigration status for each adult member in a household before issuing payment of rental assistance or down payment assistance under this chapter. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; requiring proof of citizenship or lawful immigration status as a prerequisite to receipt of rental assistance or down payment assistance; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462A.07, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462A.07, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 22.

Proof of lawful residency; housing assistance.

The agency must require proof of citizenship or lawful immigration status for each adult member in a household before issuing payment of rental assistance or down payment assistance under this chapter.
additions: Proof of lawful residency; housing assistance.

The agency must require proof of citizenship or lawful immigration status for each adult member in a household before issuing payment of rental assistance or down payment assistance under this chapter.
